steps.en: Install it; Paramiko comes along as its only runtime dependency
steps.zh: 安装；Paramiko 作为唯一运行时依赖一起装上

steps.en: Name the SSH host, your credentials and the address to reach behind it
steps.zh: 写明 SSH 主机、登录凭证，以及它背后要访问的地址

steps.en: Logs in to the SSH host with Paramiko and listens on a local port
steps.zh: 用 Paramiko 登录 SSH 主机，在本机开一个监听端口

steps.en: Point your client at the local port it reports
steps.zh: 把客户端指向它报告的本地端口

steps.en: Relays each local connection through an SSH channel to the remote address
steps.zh: 把每条本地连接经 SSH 通道转发到远端地址

value.en: A private service behind a bastion is reachable from your script as 127.0.0.1:<port>, with no ssh child process to babysit
value.zh: 堡垒机后面的私网服务，在脚本里就是 127.0.0.1:<端口>，不用看管 ssh 子进程

sources: https://github.com/pahaz/sshtunnel README (Installation: pip install sshtunnel; Usage examples 1-3: SSHTunnelForwarder / open_tunnel, remote_bind_address, local_bind_port, with-context start and stop)
